evidence.disposition: Accepted PREP12.3O inputs; no measurement recomputation or new qualification

configured_ceilings.derivation: Unchanged authoritative configured_continuation_profile.values; no ceiling is derived from a measurement maximum
configured_ceilings.units: bytes for *_bytes, counts for all other values
configured_ceilings.policy: Existing enforcement roles unchanged; the original producer transaction remains the exact byte-cap arbiter
configured_ceilings.readiness: ResourceGate.before_step retains joint identity/retirement and active-mint batch reservations; reached HISTORY_BYTES, CHECKPOINT_BYTES, PRODUCER_PENDING_ROWS or PRODUCER_PENDING_BYTES holds fresh work
configured_ceilings.capacity_claim: Configuration ceilings are not a claim that every byte cap was exercised to exhaustion

readiness_action: Unavailable, unknown or invalid required producer/physical readiness evidence denies fresh work at the existing ResourceGate; capacity holds remain latched
priority: Existing owned pending and DRY recovery branches remain before ordinary holds; no ownership, receipt, reservation or protective obligation is removed to create capacity
compatibility: Absent observation_policy preserves numerical-envelope behavior; C2 observation designation conflicts with numerical measured guards and numerical limits for its observation dimensions
evidence_binding: Existing reference reader and envelope digest bind retained observations; this document is explanatory and is not loaded as runtime configuration
unsupported_claims: No process-tree capacity inferred from child observations
No retrospective modification of retained evidence or persisted reservations
Independent original source freshness and volume-reserve contracts remain applicable
authority: This policy grants no signing, send, broadcast or real-capital authority.
